summary: Frontend-only verification of the user's 'preview not loading' report. Preview loads reliably: all 14 requested routes (/, /about, /preschool, /recreational, /competitive, /cheer, /college-recruits, /calendar, /camps, /special-events, /birthday-parties, /contact, /login, /register) return HTTP 200 and render their expected data-testids. Persistent layout is intact: main-navbar and site-footer visible on all 12 layout-routed pages; correctly absent on /login and /register (outside Layout). Backend integration works: GET /api/events returns 200 with 8 events. Reported issue does NOT reproduce.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout route + <Outlet/> pattern in App.js is correct; Navbar/Footer persist across all layout-routed pages.
Auth pages (/login, /register) are correctly kept outside the layout route.
Home hero uses a full-viewport dark overlay; if E1 wants above-the-fold copy visible immediately, consider raising hero z-index/opacity — cosmetic only.

Contact page embeds Google Maps via https://www.google.com/maps/embed which returns net::ERR_ABORTED in this preview environment (likely CSP/frame policy). Non-blocking, but consider a Maps API iframe URL or a static map fallback.

success_rate.backend: not tested (frontend-only request); /api/events probed and returned 200 with 8 events

test_credentials: admin@usgoldgym.com / GymAdmin2026! (not exercised this iteration; already verified in iteration_2)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview is healthy. All routes render; 401 on /api/auth/me is expected for logged-out users and can be ignored. Only external failed requests observed: Google Maps embed on /contact (net::ERR_ABORTED, environment/CSP) and Cloudflare cdn-cgi/rum beacons — neither affects functionality. Note: /calendar and other Programs/Events sub-links are inside Radix dropdowns, not top-level nav-link testids; use the dropdown trigger first if clicking through the header.
rca of the issue: User-reported 'preview is not loading' did NOT reproduce. Root of the earlier symptom was already fixed by E1 in the layout-route refactor (Route element={<Layout/>} with <Outlet/>) documented in iteration_2. This iteration confirms the fix holds: no blank white screen, no fatal JS errors on any page, and homepage plus every listed sub-page renders its data-testid on direct navigation.
